duration.text: The International Economic and Trade at Communication University of China is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be less than 30 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3.HSK level 6 or above 4.Applicants for degree study must participate in the entrance examination that is stipulated by CUC.
